scope: Six exposed development demonstrations, not held-out benchmark results
selection_note: Chosen before report-fact model runs to cover two numeric facts, one business fact, one supply-chain risk, one out-of-period refusal and one in-scope undisclosed customer metric. All documents belong to development. No model outputs informed selection.

cases.question: What were 3M's FY2018 capital expenditures in USD millions?
cases.review: Cash-flow statement, purchases of PP&E, 2018 column; report spending magnitude.

cases.question: What was PepsiCo's net cash provided by operating activities in FY2022, in USD millions?
cases.review: Operating cash flow, fiscal 2022 column, not investing or financing cash flow.

cases.question: According to PepsiCo's FY2022 report, what kinds of products does Frito-Lay North America sell?
cases.review: Quote must identify FLNA branded convenient foods, such as dips and snack chips, rather than another division's beverages. Inspect the original page and local section heading. A valid alternative page needs an explicit review note.

cases.question: What supply-chain risk involving limited suppliers does PepsiCo describe in its FY2022 report?
cases.review: Quote must directly discuss some materials having limited or sole suppliers and resulting supply-disruption risk. Check relevance, not just whether a verbatim string exists.

cases.question: What was 3M's FY2024 revenue in USD millions?
cases.review: 2018 report cannot disclose actual FY2024 revenue. Explicitly label programmatic scope refusal.

cases.question: How much revenue did PepsiCo receive specifically from Microsoft in FY2022? Answer in USD millions.
cases.review: The full report does not separately disclose this customer-level figure; do not substitute total revenue or infer zero business. Prior full-text source review is recorded in CORPUS.md.
